# Security Checklist: Product Line B Onboarding Smoke

**Purpose**: Validate SPEC-010B security requirements before task generation
**Created**: 2026-06-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Secret And Evidence Redaction

- [x] CHK001 Are forbidden secret-bearing evidence fields explicitly named for seed CLI errors, residue entries, optional live GitHub evidence, and smoke packet notes? [Completeness, Spec Clarifications - Synthetic Smoke And Evidence, Contract seed-product-line-cli - Error And Residue Object Shapes, Contract smoke-evidence - Optional Live Issue Status]
- [x] CHK002 Is redaction proof objectively measurable with boolean or count evidence such as `raw_secret_values_emitted: false`, `token_set`, stable error codes, and forbidden-field absence? [Measurability, Spec FR-014, Contract seed-product-line-cli - Required Result Envelope, Contract smoke-evidence - Optional Live Issue Status]
- [x] CHK003 Are operator-facing error messages required to exclude raw SQL, stack traces, raw upstream responses, token values, authorization headers, API keys, credentials, and matched secret substrings? [Completeness, Contract seed-product-line-cli - Error And Residue Object Shapes]
- [x] CHK004 Are retained inventory identifiers constrained to stable names or hashes so FocusEngine/OpenClaw evidence cannot expose credentials or raw runtime configuration? [Clarity, Data Model - RetainedInventoryReport]

## GitHub Credential And Mutation Boundary

- [x] CHK005 Are optional live GitHub credential requirements limited to explicit operator approval, the existing live-mutation opt-in path, and permission to read open issues and create one issue? [Completeness, Spec Clarifications - Synthetic Smoke And Evidence]
- [x] CHK006 Are allowed live GitHub writes limited to finding/reusing one safe open Product Line B smoke issue or creating exactly one Product Line B synthetic issue with creation-time title, body, and labels only? [Scope Control, Spec Clarifications - Synthetic Smoke And Evidence]
- [x] CHK007 Are forbidden GitHub writes explicitly listed, including automatic label repair, comments, close/delete, PR creation, repo sync ownership enablement, and Product Line A mutation? [Completeness, Spec PR Review Packet Requirements, Quickstart - HAL UAT]
- [x] CHK008 Are missing credentials, insufficient permissions, and operator refusal specified as skipped or not-mutated optional evidence that cannot fail the required synthetic smoke? [Consistency, Spec Clarifications - Synthetic Smoke And Evidence, Contract smoke-evidence - Optional Live Issue Status]

## Workspace Scope And Access Control

- [x] CHK009 Are invalid, forbidden, and out-of-scope workspace outcomes mapped to stable evidence codes and HTTP statuses for the required scoped routes? [Completeness, Contract scoped-dashboard-evidence - API Evidence]
- [x] CHK010 Are unauthorized Product Line A and Product Line B scoped API outcomes required for every route used as security-relevant isolation evidence? [Coverage, Contract scoped-dashboard-evidence - API Evidence]
- [x] CHK011 Are Product Line A and Product Line B API evidence requirements tied to explicit `workspace_id` values so facility/global scope cannot satisfy isolation proof by accident? [Clarity, Spec Clarifications - Isolation Assertions, Contract scoped-dashboard-evidence - API Evidence]
- [x] CHK012 Are disabled Product Line B inspection paths separated from normal dashboard switcher eligibility so disabled workspace data is not exposed through the active-only UI scope? [Consistency, Spec FR-006, Contract scoped-dashboard-evidence - Switcher Evidence]

## Runtime Identity And Ownership Takeover

- [x] CHK013 Are retained FocusEngine/OpenClaw identities defined as non-blocking inventory unless explicitly assigned to Product Line B or conflicting `plb-platform-*` ownership? [Clarity, Spec FR-003, Data Model - RetainedInventoryReport]
- [x] CHK014 Are Product Line B logical agents required to use `plb-platform-*` assignment names instead of harness manifest IDs or retained runtime identities? [Consistency, Spec FR-011, Data Model - ProductLineBSeedConfig]
- [x] CHK015 Are repo sync owner and GitHub sync ownership takeover risks required to stop before mutation with typed evidence? [Coverage, Spec FR-003, Contract seed-product-line-cli - Product Line B Assertions]
- [x] CHK016 Are Product Line B enablement requirements narrow enough to avoid enabling scheduler dispatch, claim/retry authority, runner state, sandbox lifecycle, adapter behavior, auto-merge, or broad GitHub sync automation? [Scope Control, Spec FR-007, Spec FR-010, Plan - State Management Contract]

## Product Line A Isolation

- [x] CHK017 Are Product Line A before/after security-relevant surfaces scoped to Product Line A ownership, task state, sync ownership, GitHub sync lifecycle, counters, and non-owned flags? [Completeness, Spec FR-013, Contract scoped-dashboard-evidence - SQL Evidence]
- [x] CHK018 Are Product Line A isolation violations required to stop the workflow rather than continue with partial or global evidence? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK019 Are Product Line B expected rows excluded from Product Line A drift calculations so isolation evidence cannot hide real Product Line A mutation behind whole-database counts? [Measurability, Contract scoped-dashboard-evidence - SQL Evidence]

## Parallel Safety And Review Packet

- [x] CHK020 Are SPEC-014C-owned adapter, runtime-inventory, dispatch, and sandbox paths explicitly forbidden for SPEC-010B implementation tasks? [Dependency, Spec FR-011, Plan - Scope Boundaries]
- [x] CHK021 Are runtime-inventory requirements limited to optional read-only support and excluded from closeout eligibility gates? [Consistency, Spec FR-011, Contract smoke-evidence - Parallel Safety]
- [x] CHK022 Is the PR/evidence packet required to call out live GitHub write limits, redacted credential-safe metadata, Product Line A isolation, Product Line B disablement, files avoided, and adapter ownership not taken? [Traceability, Spec PR Review Packet Requirements, Contract smoke-evidence - Parallel Safety]

## Notes

- Focus areas: secret emission, GitHub credential/mutation boundary, workspace-scope access control, runtime identity takeover, Product Line A isolation, and SPEC-014C parallel safety.
- Depth: Standard reviewer gate before task generation.
- Actor/timing: PR reviewer, task author, and security reviewer before Phase 5 tasks.
